clauses: This highly esteemed immunologist and researcher has made monumental contributions to biomedical science.

Their groundbreaking work has been widely recognized by the scientific community, earning them prestigious honors such as the Ernst Jung Prize for Medicine, the Albany Medical Center Prize, and the Dr.
Paul Janssen Award for Biomedical Research.
Despite their profound international impact on medicine and biology, they were not educated at the Pasteur Institute, nor have they ever been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
